description: Simulation rules were re-negotiated from scratch at the start of each mission and not consistently documented across crews.
response: Each Commander sets rules; rigour varies. Crew 16's Commander noted the high-fidelity environment itself encourages discipline even without strict rules.
lesson: Agree and publish simulation rules before arrival on Devon: airlock protocol (5-min hold), who can break sim and for what reasons, comms delay setting, EVA request and approval chain. Do not improvise these on-site.
